title: galium multiflorum subsp. hirsutum
intro: Galium multiflorum subsp. hirsutum, commonly known as Rough Bedstraw, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including wounds, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide relief and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of Rough Bedstraw, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative effects. The plant's health benefits also include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit anticancer properties, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
